A false condition returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than the typed question's negative Boolean. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 similarly returns OUT_OF_SCOPE outside linked promotion. A deliberately narrower assessment domain is possible but is not established by the stated actor scope.

The offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift component. They must connect the same gift component to the promotion; otherwise mixed-purpose offers may be overincluded.

The SFC-authorised-fund limitation follows the circular's local distributor definition in db43e253bea18.u0.2. It does not establish the complete scope of paragraph 3.11, quoted in broader investment-product terms.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to FAQ question 1 issued on 30 September 2010 are identified but not supplied as external dependencies. Can their applicable versions be supplied to verify the complete gift standard?

Gift status, discount status and offer attribution remain supplied judgments. Guaranteed returns or incentives are not automatically gifts. The detailed funding and fulfilment qualifications in node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b are not independently established by the circular; node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 must not interpret provider as requiring funding or fulfilment.

Passing the selected gift control establishes no permission under section 103, disclosure requirements or advertising controls. Section 103 authorisation or exemption likewise supplies no stated gift exception.

Footnote 1 is supplied, contrary to the disclosure claim's uncertainty annotation. The extracted disclosure duty is supported but does not exhaust the accompanying principal-loss disclosure requirement.

The advertising-authority alternatives remain distinct: the circular establishes the narrow instruction directly, while fuller verification may require the Advertising Guidelines, supplements and Code paragraph 2.3. Those external texts are absent; their necessity for this narrow claim remains uncertain.
The supplied source establishes no operative start or end dates. Temporal runtime safeguards do not establish the applicable legal version.
